arxiv-1705-10537.title: Beam-driven, Plasma-based Particle Accelerators
arxiv-1705-10537.creator: P. Muggli
arxiv-1705-10537.description: Abstract We briefly give some of the characteristics of the beam-driven, plasma-based particle accelerator known as the plasma wakefield accelerator (PWFA). We also mention some of the major results that have been obtained since the birth of the concept. We focus on high-energy particle beams where possible. Keywords Plasma; particle accelerator; plasma-based accelerator; plasma wakefield; beam-plasma interaction. 0.

arxiv-2105-14417.title: Overparameterization of deep ResNet: zero loss and mean-field analysis
arxiv-2105-14417.creator: Zhiyan Ding zding49@math.wisc.edu, Shi Chen schen636@wisc.edu, Qin Li qinli@math.wisc.edu, Stephen J. Wright swright@cs.wisc.edu
arxiv-2105-14417.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Zhiyan Ding zding49@math.wisc.edu, Shi Chen schen636@wisc.edu, Qin Li qinli@math.wisc.edu, Stephen J. Wright swright@cs.wisc.edu. Finding parameters in a deep neural network (NN) that fit training data is a nonconvex optimization problem, but a basic first-order optimization method (gradient descent) finds a global optimizer with perfect fit (zero-loss) in many practical situations.

arxiv-2208-03433.title: Global existence and finite time blowup for a mixed pseudo-parabolic p p -Laplacian type equation Journal: Journal
arxiv-2208-03433.creator: Jiazhuo Cheng, Qiru Wang
arxiv-2208-03433.description: Abstract This paper concerns the initial-boundary value problem for a mixed pseudo-parabolic p p -Laplacian type equation. By constructing a family of potential wells, we first present the explicit expression for the depth of potential well, and then prove the existence, uniqueness and decay estimate of global solutions and the blowup phenomena of solutions with subcritical initial energy.

arxiv-2301-07709.title: Compressive Raman microspectroscopy parallelized by single-photon avalanche diode arrays
arxiv-2301-07709.creator: Clémence Gentner, Samuel Burri, Edoardo Charbon, Claudio Bruschini, Hilton B. de Aguiar
arxiv-2301-07709.description: Abstract We demonstrate an efficient and scalable compressive Raman parallelization scheme based on single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) arrays to reach pixel dwell times of 23 µs, representing over 10 × \times speed-up using the otherwise weak spontaneous Raman effect. \metadata []✉ For correspondenceclaudio.bruschini@epfl.ch, h.aguiar@lkb.ens.fr www.lkb.upmc.fr/opticalimaging/ www.epfl.ch/labs/aqua/ \metadata [ \authfn 1]These authors contributed equally to the work.

arxiv-2310-14875.title: Benefit of enhanced electrostatic and optical accelerometry for future gravimetry missions. Note: Journal: Advances in Space Research
arxiv-2310-14875.creator: Alexey Kupriyanov, Arthur Reis, Manuel Schilling, Vitali Müller, Jürgen Müller
arxiv-2310-14875.description: Abstract Twenty years of gravity observations from various satellite missions have provided unique data about mass redistribution processes in the Earth system, such as melting of Greenland’s ice shields, sea level changes, ground and underground water depletion, droughts, floods, etc.

arxiv-2502-15967.title: Generalizing the enhanced power graph of a group with respect to automorphisms
arxiv-2502-15967.creator: Abbas Mohammadian, Ismail Guloglu, Ahmad Erfanian, Mark L. Lewis
arxiv-2502-15967.description: Abstract . We generalize the enhanced power graph by replacing elements with classes under automorphisms. We show that the connectivity and diameter of this graph is similar to that of the enhanced power graph. We consider the universal vertices of this graph and when this graph is a complete graph. Finally, we classify when this graph is the empty graph.

arxiv-2506-12661.title: INTERPOS: Interaction Rhythm Guided Positional Morphing for Mobile App Recommender Systems
arxiv-2506-12661.creator: M.H. Maqbool ♣ , Moghis Fereidouni ♡ , Umar Farooq ♠ , A.B. Siddique ♡ , Hassan Foroosh ♢
arxiv-2506-12661.description: Abstract The mobile app market has expanded exponentially, offering millions of apps with diverse functionalities, yet research in mobile app recommendation remains limited. Traditional sequential recommender systems utilize the order of items in users’ historical interactions to predict the next item for the users.

arxiv-2510-01268.title: AdaDetectGPT: Adaptive Detection of LLM-Generated Text with Statistical Guarantees
arxiv-2510-01268.creator: Hongyi ZhouDepartment of MathematicsTsinghua UniversityBeijing, ChinaJin ZhuSchool of MathematicsUniversity of BirminghamBirmingham, UKPingfan SuDepartment of StatisticsLSELondon, UKKai YeDepartment of StatisticsLSELondon, UKYing YangDepartment of Statistics and Data ScienceTsinghua UniversityBeijin
arxiv-2510-01268.description: Abstract We study the problem of determining whether a piece of text has been authored by a human or by a large language model (LLM). Existing state of the art logits-based detectors make use of statistics derived from the log-probability of the observed text evaluated using the distribution function of a given source LLM.

arxiv-2601-07285.title: On faithfulness and DP-transformations generated by arithmetic Cantor series expansions
arxiv-2601-07285.creator: Grygoriy Torbin 1,2 , Yuliia Voloshyn 3
arxiv-2601-07285.description: Abstract . The paper is devoted to the study of conditions for the Hausdorff-Besicovitch faithfulness of the family of cylinders generated by Cantor series expansions. We show that there exist subgeometric Cantor series expansions for which the corresponding families of cylinders are not faithful for the Hausdorff-Besicovitch dimension on the unit interval.

pmc-10579437.title: Molecular regulation of neutrophil swarming in health and disease: Lessons from the phagocyte oxidase
pmc-10579437.creator: Zhimin Song, Sourav Bhattacharya, Regina A. Clemens, Mary C. Dinauer
pmc-10579437.description: SummaryNeutrophil swarming is a complex coordinated process in which neutrophils sensing pathogen or damage signals are rapidly recruited to sites of infections or injuries. This process involves cooperation between neutrophils where autocrine and paracrine positive-feedback loops, mediated by receptor/ligand pairs including lipid chemoattractants and chemokines, amplify localized recruitment of neutrophils.

pmc-10701450.title: Protocol to image and analyze hippocampal network dynamics in non-anesthetized mouse pups
pmc-10701450.creator: Mirindra R Ratsifandrihamanana, Robin F Dard, Julien Denis, Rosa Cossart, Michel A Picardo
pmc-10701450.description: SummaryTwo-photon calcium imaging is a powerful technique that has revolutionized our understanding of how neural circuit dynamics supports different behaviors and cognitive processes. However, performing imaging during development remains challenging. Here, we provide a protocol to image CA1 neurons in mouse pups as well as a pipeline of analysis to analyze and share the data.

pmc-10743698.title: Genome-Wide Identification, Characterization, and Expression Analysis of the Copper-Containing Amine Oxidase Gene Family in Mangrove Kandelia obovata
pmc-10743698.creator: Quaid Hussain, Ting Ye, Chenjing Shang, Sihui Li, Jackson Nkoh Nkoh, Wenyi Li, Zhangli Hu
pmc-10743698.description: Copper-containing amine oxidases (CuAOs) are known to have significant involvement in the process of polyamine catabolism, as well as serving crucial functions in plant development and response to abiotic stress. A genome-wide investigation of the CuAO protein family was previously carried out in sweet orange (Citrus sinensis) and sweet cherry (Prunus avium L.).

pmc-12447356.title: Contralateral Distal Fibula Plate for Proximal Radius Fracture: A Technical Case Report
pmc-12447356.creator: Jayanth Kumar, Alex Moses, Porter Young, Adam Gitlin
pmc-12447356.description: Proximal radius fractures are injuries that are very difficult to manage, given the complex anatomy and the rarity of the fracture. Typical fixation of the proximal radius involves open reduction and internal fixation. However, this fixation is challenging given the paucity of proximal radius-specific plating systems.

pmc-12745944.title: Editorial for the special issue “Pancreatic imaging: Recent advancements and new frontiers”
pmc-12745944.creator: Piero Boraschi
pmc-12745944.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). for early and accurate diagnosis [1]. Advances in imaging modalities – particularly high-resolution MRI, multiphasic CT, endoscopic ultrasound, and functional imaging – have markedly improved the visualization of pancreatic lesions, ductal changes, and subtle parenchymal alterations [2], [3]. This Special Issue, titled “Pancreatic Imaging: Recent Advancements and New Frontiers”, presents a collection of high-quality articles that reflect the current state of the art, showcasing the rapid progress and expanding frontiers in this field.

pmc-12764071.title: The impact of neighborhood-level racial and economic segregation on low-risk cesarean delivery among Black, White, and Biracial (Black/White) individuals
pmc-12764071.creator: Ella Batterson, Shira Goldenberg, Rebecca J Baer, Gretchen Bandoli
pmc-12764071.description: BackgroundResearch has established Black-White low-risk cesarean delivery (CD) disparities; however, it is unknown how select structural factors are involved in this disparity and whether Biracial (Black/White) individuals face similar disparities. Our objective was to estimate the association of low-risk CD among Black, White and Biracial individuals, and determine whether these associations vary by neighborhood level racial and economic segregation.

pmc-12884432.title: ZSF1 lean rats – How healthy are they?
pmc-12884432.creator: Antje Schauer, Beatrice Vahle, Volker Adams, Axel Linke, Antje Augstein
pmc-12884432.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ZSF1 lean rats are widely used as controls in cardiometabolic studies involving ZSF1 obese rats, which develop a cardiometabolic syndrome and diastolic dysfunction at a young age due to a double leptin receptor mutation (Leprcp and Leprfa). Although, lean littermates show no overt signs of cardiometabolic disease or diastolic impact, they belong to one of three genotypic variants, two of which carry one of the mutant Lepr alleles and, thus, doubt has been raised about their suitability as healthy controls.

pmc-13061779.title: Transstadial and transovarial perpetuations of Borrelia venezuelensis in Ornithodoros rudis, with demonstration of vector competence
pmc-13061779.creator: Felipe R Jorge, Glauber M B de Oliveira, Igor S Silito, Matheus Pasini Martins, Sebastián Muñoz-Leal, Marcelo B Labruna
pmc-13061779.description: Ticks of the genus Ornithodoros are recognized vectors of relapsing fever group Borrelia, such as Borrelia venezuelensis, whose infection dynamics in its vector, Ornithodoros rudis, remains poorly understood in Brazil. This study aimed to investigate the transstadial perpetuation and transovarial transmission of B. venezuelensis in O. rudis and the vector competence of all parasitic stages of this tick species.

pmc-13287269.creator: R-Y Yang, T. Seailles, N. Aisenberg, O. Felix, A. Sabil, P. Escourrou

pmc-13299976.title: Radiolabeled Antimicrobials for Infection Imaging: A Scoping Review
pmc-13299976.creator: Sichen Liu, James Townley, Chuen-Yen Lau
pmc-13299976.description: Imaging of infections has the potential to improve clinical outcomes, but pathogen-specific imaging strategies are currently unavailable. Given their target specificity, antimicrobials may be useful as molecular imaging ligands to target infections. Despite substantial development efforts, no antimicrobial-based ligands are approved for clinical use.

pmc-13335490.title: Optimization of SWCNT‐FET Biosensors by Aptamer Engineering and Toehold‐Mediated Strand Displacement
pmc-13335490.creator: Haosen Miao, Tingting Zheng, Houlin Yu, Gririraj Manoharan, Gustavo Sant'Anna, Nicholas Bedfrod, Jorge L Chávez, Chang‐Seuk Lee, Matteo Palma
pmc-13335490.description: Aptamer‐based single‐walled carbon nanotube (SWCNT) field‐effect transistor (FET) biosensors provide a compact, label‐free, and sensitive platform for real‐time biomarker detection. To enhance device performance, we employed a truncated DNA aptamer (CSS.3_cut3) with improved conformational switching upon cortisol binding, boosting the sensitivity of SWCNT‐FET biosensors.

pmc-13408345.title: Cancer immunotherapy targeting murine myeloid cells requires endosomal pattern recognition
pmc-13408345.creator: Yueyun Pan, Shengduo Pei, Heng Liang, Kajsa Westberg, Lars Nitschke, Xinsong Chen, Yinda Yu, Ning He, Qirong Lin, Li Lei, Anton Gisterå, Johan Hartman, Jeffrey V Ravetch, Tak W Mak, Tracy L McGaha, Mikael C I Karlsson

pmc-13427012.title: Circulating Omentin-1 Across BMI Categories in Type 2 Diabetes and its Association with Insulin Resistance: A Cross-Sectional Study from South India
pmc-13427012.creator: Saidaiah Ikkurthi, A. R. Srinivasan, Vaikkakara Suresh, Rajendran Jayanthi, Vidya S. Desai
pmc-13427012.description: Introduction:Omentin-1 is an adipocytokine predominantly secreted by visceral adipose tissue and associated with insulin sensitivity. Altered levels of omentin-1 in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and obesity denote a potential link with insulin resistance.Methods:Two hundred twenty-five adult males with T2DM were segregated into non-obese (n = 75), overweight (n = 75), and obese (n = 75) groups.

pmc-13522214.title: Comparative analysis of gut and ovarian microbiota in Dactylopius opuntiae (Hemiptera: Dactylopiidae) from distinct Moroccan regions
pmc-13522214.creator: Oumaima Moustaid, Mohamed Idbella, Salah Eddine Azaroual, Karim El Fakhouri, Chaimae Ramdani, Mohamed Ouaarous, Mustapha El Bouhssini, Issam Meftah Kadmiri
pmc-13522214.description: IntroductionInvestigating the hidden microbial world within insect hosts yields new insights into their biology, ecology, and adaptation. Dactylopius opuntiae (Cockerell), a major invasive pest of the cactus Opuntia ficus-indica, causes severe economic and ecological damage in Morocco and other arid regions. However, little is known about its associated bacterial microbiota and how it varies across environmental gradients.
